num_jobs: <int> Total number of jobs to be scheduled.
num_machines: <int> Total number of machines in the job shop.
num_operations: <int> Total number of operations across all jobs.
due_date_factor: <float> Multiplier applied to each job's total processing time to compute its due date.

jobs.job_id: <int> Unique identifier for the job, indexed from 0.
jobs.weight: <int> Priority weight of the job, used to penalize late completion.
jobs.release_date: <int> Earliest time at which the job's first operation may begin processing.
jobs.due_date: <int> Target completion time for the job.

operations.machine: <int> Machine on which this operation must be processed.
operations.processing_time: <int> Time required to process this operation on its assigned machine.
